mapper.sql: id, student_id, mission_id, mission_version_id, rubric_version_id, grade, status, started_at, finished_at, completed_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attempt () VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{missionId}, #{missionVersionId}, #{rubricVersionId}, #{grade}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (student_id, mission_id) WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM attempt WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND mission_id = #{missionId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hint_usage (id, attempt_id, hint_question_id, opened_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{attemptId}, #{hintQuestionId}, #{openedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT hint_question_id FROM hint_usage WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId}
